title: pseudodissochaeta subsessilis
intro: Pseudodissochaeta subsessilis, commonly known as a plant species, is a type of medicinal plant that belongs to the family of Asteraceae. The therapeutic actions of Pseudodissochaeta subsessilis include wound healing, fever reduction, and the treatment of respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders.
